import numpy as np, json
def comps_of(A):
    H,W=A.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(A,bool); out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if A[r,c]!=0 and not seen[r,c]:
                col=int(A[r,c]); comp={(r,c)}; seen[r,c]=True; stack=[(r,c)]
                while stack:
                    rr,cc=stack.pop()
                    for dr in(-1,0,1):
                        for dc in(-1,0,1):
                            x,y=rr+dr,cc+dc
                            if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and A[x,y]==col and (x,y) not in comp:
                                comp.add((x,y)); seen[x,y]=True; stack.append((x,y))
                rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs_=[p[1] for p in comp]
                out.append({'c':col,'rows':min(rs),'r1':max(rs),'cols':min(cs_),'c1':max(cs_)})
    return out
def f(inp):
    A=np.array(inp); H,W=A.shape
    cs=comps_of(A)
    # host = multi-cell blob; band/sequence = collection of other comps
    blob=max(cs,key=lambda x:(x['r1']+1-x['rows'])*(x['c1']+1-x['cols']))
    others=[x for x in cs if x is not blob]
    seq=[x['c'] for x in sorted(others,key=lambda x:(x['rows'],x['cols']))]
    host=blob
    c0=r0=x['cols']; c1=r1=x['r1']
    host_r0=host['rows']; host_c0=host['cols']
    pat=[[int(A[host_r0+k][host_c0+l]) for l in range(host['c1']-host['cols']+1)] for k in range(host['r1']-host['rows']+1)]
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    hostcells=set(host['cells']) if False else {(r_,c_) for r_ in range(host_r0,host['r1']+1) for c_ in range(host_c0,host['c1']+1) if int(A[r_,c_])==int(A[host_r0,c0])}
    # build host cells set from comp cells
    hcells=set(host['cells'])
    for i,c in enumerate(seq[:-1]):
        nxt=seq[i+1]
        if int(A[host_r0+c0])==nxt: continue
        p=pat
        # n-th stamp uses pattern of host (same shape), colored n
        pass
    # general: stamp for color c adjacent left of the comp representing the NEXT seq element
    # find next-comps dict
    next_comp={}
    for idx,x in enumerate(seq):
        if idx<len(seq)-1:
            next_comp[x]=[y for y in seq[idx+1:] if True][0] if False else None
    # simpler direct: stamp c adjacent to the nearest component whose color == next after c in seq
    for i,c in enumerate(seq):
        nxt=seq[(i+1)%len(seq)]
        if i==len(seq)-1: continue  # wraparound handled by others having comp
        target=[x for x in others if x['c']==nxt][0]
        p=pat
        hh=len(p); ww=len(p[0])
        tr,tc=target['rows'],target['cols']
        # c precedes target => c goes immediately left of target's pattern window
        ll=tc-ww; rr=host_r0

    # handle wrap-around (last color): goes right of the host if no host for it

    # colors whose comp exists already have their cells kept

        for k in range(hh):

    # delete band comps and recolor: erase all band comp cells
    for cc in others+[list(sorted([x for x in cs if x is not blob]))[0]]: pass
    # erase: remove band comp cells (all comps except blob)
    for x in [y for y in cs if y is not blob]:
